scope: Explicit required Core/Arch/default and industrial source identity closure, exact G4/ThreadX locks, whole-SDK verification through standalone installed-lock CLI before trusting recorded dependency commits
conclusions: Required payload names are independent of the observed installed file map; rehashing an omission cannot redefine required surfaces. Core fault/stack, Arch mechanisms/sleep, OS mask hooks, common I2C, CAN/USB/ETH/timer/clock and selected private/controller headers are explicitly required. This is an identity contract, while CMake remains the source/target graph authority.

Required G4 official payload derives from the reviewed exact five-file lock, including original Apache notice. Owned G474 system/GPIO/LPUART/private headers/facts/provider emitters and software reference are separately required; other SDK files are not implicitly admitted.

G4 development verification requires canonical paths, actual official origin/HEAD, clean source, exact five-file bytes, stable lock/source identities. Packaged verification requires a matching dependency commit supplied only after whole-SDK verification; no missing-Git fallback.

G4 and ThreadX standalone CLI use exists OR is_symlink for the SDK manifest. A dangling manifest reaches whole-package regular-file rejection rather than a valid nested Git checkout bypass. Exact installed SDK source/lock locations are enforced.

Whole-SDK verification checks canonical regular root, duplicate/unknown metadata fields, source payload map/readback, additional/missing files, explicit required presence, source/package digests, exported CMake files, approved module declarations and required dependency records. ThreadX and G4 byte/graph locks and reviewed GD import notices remain verified.

Development overlay and publishable source paths remain distinct: publishable payload uses original committed Git blob bytes and clean source, development packaging is explicitly nonpublishable. Source SDK and dependency verification never establish physical runtime qualification.
owner_execution_note: Owner reports whole43 SDK cases and installed G4 baremetal/FreeRTOS links; this reviewer did not rerun or adopt those executions.
limitations: Unsigned SDK metadata is not an authenticated release or adversarial publisher trust proof. Reviewed local tooling and approved source locks are trusted inputs.
This targeted read reviews listed closure and CLI paths, not every SDK source or every possible future profile.
G4 generated cold cleanup privilege gap is tracked separately with bus/cfg/root and is not closed by source packaging identity.
